analysis.reasonEn: RSI remains at 44.5 in the neutral zone, while the MACD histogram has worsened to -0.0014, continuing the weak trend. The volume ratio compared to the 5-day average is 0.47, indicating contraction. The current price is not significantly deviated from SMA200 (-0.68%) and is trading sideways around the Bollinger Band middle line. The 5-day and 20-day high/low patterns show no clear direction, making a wait-and-see approach appropriate.
